title: My Sister's Diary ANSWERS Me 📓
description:
Years ago my grandma gave my big sister and me matching diaries. Mine stayed blank in a drawer, until last week, when it started filling up with her words, in my handwriting, as she wrote.

I shouldn't have read it. I definitely shouldn't have written back.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment INK if you'd have written back too.
